scope: Developer-authored synthetic frozen probe; not an independent blind test or real enterprise ROI. No corpus changes to fit these queries; labels are withheld from generation. live subset declared before first run.
selection_rule: Default changes require zero scope leaks/errors/degraded retrieval, hybrid recall@2 >= BM25 and more recalled cases in paraphrase/mixed groups; no fewer provisional live semantic passes than BM25; warm uncached p95 <= 250ms and first vector retrieval <= 15000ms on this host. This is a demo acceptance budget, not a universal SLO. Otherwise retain BM25; never delete negative results.
